name: Fire Nova Bomb · Lightning
primary:
A projectile flies where you look and explodes in a 7-block radius on hit. Effects:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ fire + 4.5 ❤ arcane + 3 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 21.6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Arcane instability: −0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
self_description:
An explosion around you with a 5.08-block radius, hitting you as well:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 21.6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Arcane instability: −0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Charge 20: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
